report.summary: Deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 introduced a NullPointerException regression in PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 when payer_vpa is null, causing approximately 15-20% failure rates across payment attempts starting at 14:03.

ranked_hypotheses.title: payments-api v2.14.0 deployment introduces a NullPointerException during PaymentIntentValidator validation when payer_vpa is null

supporting.note: Deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 at 14:02:00 explicitly refactored payment-intent validation.
Error rate spiked sharply starting at 14:03:00, reaching over 20%.
Mobile-bff error rate mirrored the spike starting at 14:03:00.
NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.validate(PaymentIntentValidator.java:88): payer_vpa is null started immediately after deploy at 14:03:05.
mobile-bff logged upstream 500 errors responding to POST /v1/payments/intent starting at 14:03:01.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Upstream NPCI switch or UPI Gateway degradation causing request failures

contradicting.note: upi-gateway error rate remained entirely stable and normal (~0.25%) throughout the incident window.
Errors are internal NullPointerExceptions in payments-api code, not gateway timeouts or external failures.

facts.text: payments-api error rate spiked starting at 14:03:00, peaking at 20.29%.
mobile-bff error rate spiked starting at 14:03:00, peaking at 6.29%.
payments-api v2.14.0 was deployed at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 with summary 'payments-api v2.14.0: refactor payment-intent validation, bump json library'.
payments-api began logging NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.validate(PaymentIntentValidator.java:88): payer_vpa is null at 14:03:05.
mobile-bff logged upstream payments-api responded 500 errors starting at 14:03:01.
upi-gateway error rate remained stable with no anomaly during the incident window.

assumptions: The code refactor in payments-api v2.14.0 altered field handling such that requests lacking or having null payer_vpa are no longer safely defaulted or filtered before reaching validation.
evidence_gaps: Exact request payloads containing null payer_vpa were not inspected via raw packet or full request log inspection.

timeline.event: Error rate anomaly begins on payments-api and mobile-bff
mobile-bff logs first upstream 500 error from payments-api
payments-api logs first NullPointerException in PaymentIntentValidator
Incident INC-01 reported by on-call SRE Priya

recommended_actions.rationale: Rolls back the bad deployment chg-9890 which introduced the NullPointerException regression.
Ensures requests with missing or null payer_vpa are safely validated or rejected with proper client error responses instead of unhandled 500 exceptions.

recommended_actions.action: Add integration test coverage for null or missing payment intent fields
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents similar validation regressions from passing CI/CD pipelines.
